name: model_op_lightning_indexer
description: Lightning Indexer: per-query-token sparse key selection for DeepSeek-style sparse attention (FlagGems-vllm PR #799, lightning_indexer). query [T, 64, 128] bfloat16 in TND layout; key [num_blocks, 128, 1, 128] bfloat16 as a PA_BSND paged cache; weights [T, 64] bfloat16 are the per-head score weights; actual_seq_lengths_query [batch] int32 is cumulative query lengths; actual_seq_lengths_key [batch] int32 is per-request key lengths; block_table [batch, width] int32 maps logical to physical key blocks. For each query token the causal active key length is key_length - (query_end - token) + 1; when that is at most sparse_count the exact arange of positions is emitted, otherwise the score sum over heads of relu(q @ k^T) weighted by weights is reduced and the top sparse_count positions are selected. Returns (indices [T, 1, sparse_count] int32, values) where unfilled slots are -1 and values is an empty tensor unless return_value. Only layout_query TND, layout_key PA_BSND, sparse_mode 3 and default token windows are supported. Index order within a row is unspecified: correctness compares the selected index multiset per row.
